 News › News News › CAT 2026 Admit Card to be OUT on Nov 4: Know where & how to download CAT 2026 Admit Card to be OUT on Nov 4: Know where & how to download
 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Nov 2, 2026, 15:01 IST CAT admit card 2026 to be out on November 4 CAT Admit Card 2026 : Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Indore is set to release the CAT 2026 admit card on November 4, 2026. Once released, candidates shall be able to download their CAT admit cards online through official website iimcat.ac.in. CAT admit card download link will be activated on candidate login portal. One needs to enter their registered user ID and password to download CAT 2026 admit card .
 IIM CAT admit card is an important document for appearing in the examination. It contains details such as candidate's examination centre, allotted test slot, reporting time and exam-day instructions. CAT 2026 will be conducted on November 29, 2026, in three sessions. Candidates are advised to download their CAT hall ticket as soon as it becomes available and check all details carefully.
 Where to download CAT 2026 admit card? 
 Candidates can download CAT 2026 admit card from official website - iimcat.ac.in. 
 IIM Indore will activate CAT admit card download link on candidate login dashboard.
 Candidates should use official portal to download CAT 2026 hall ticket. They should avoid relying on unofficial websites or third-party links for downloading examination document.
 Steps to download CAT admit card 2026 
 Once iimcat.ac.in admit card 2026 link is activated, candidates can follow these steps below to download their CAT hall tickets
 Go to official website at iimcat.ac.in
 Click on registered candidate login link available on homepage
 Enter CAT 2026 user ID and password
 Submit login credentials to access candidate dashboard
 Click on CAT admit card download link
 Admit CARD PDF will appear on screen
 Download and save it
 CAT 2026 Exam Date and Slot Timings 
 IIM Indore will conduct CAT 2026 on November 29, 2026. The examination will be held in three sessions on same day. Candidates will be allotted a particular session based on their examination schedule. CAT 2026 exam timings are given below:
 Exam Slot Timings 
 Slot 1 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM 
 Slot 2 12:30 PM to 2:30 PM 
 Slot 3 4:30 PM to 6:30 PM 
 Candidates must check their individual CAT admit cards for exact reporting time, gate-closing time and examination centre details. The session timings mentioned above should not be treated as individual reporting times.
 End of Article
